title: Reaction-Ball Catch Warm-Up
description: A short partner catching warm-up using quick, low tosses to sharpen hands and reaction time before passing drills begin.

content.objective: Sharpen hand-eye coordination and soft hands before the ball moves at full speed.
content.setup: Partners stand three metres apart, each pair with one ball.
instructions: Toss the ball low and slightly off-target so the partner has to adjust.
Catch with both hands and immediately give a target before returning the toss.
After one minute, take one step farther apart and repeat.
Finish with ten one-handed catches per side.
coachingPoints: Catch out in front of the body, not against the chest.
Keep the eyes on the ball all the way into the hands.
Give a quick, clear target hand after every catch.
commonMistakes: Tossing too hard, turning this into a throwing drill.
Catching flat-footed instead of stepping to the ball.
Letting the group's pace drift apart instead of staying together.
content.safety: Keep pairs spread out so stray tosses don't hit a neighbouring group.
